description: Client configuration for the Cloudflare Worker proxy. The Worker owns provider selection and credentials, so no key or token appears here (ADR 0003, ADR 0009).

baseUrl.note: The deployed Worker name is still an open question in docs/06-pipeline.md; confirm and replace '<account>' before M1.

transport.payloadLimitNote: 64 KiB is the current cap on the template chat route in docs/02-architecture.md; per-workflow caps are enforced by the Worker.

endpoints.name: pronunciation-feedback
endpoints.fallback: Replay reference and attempt side by side with a stored generic tip.

endpoints.name: conversation-turn
endpoints.fallback: A scripted scenario line keeps the exchange moving offline.

endpoints.name: speech-synthesis
endpoints.fallback: Reference clips are always local; an unsynthesized reply is shown as text.

endpoints.name: response-transcription
endpoints.fallback: Tap-only drills, which always work offline.

endpoints.name: progress-summary
endpoints.fallback: A canned summary rendered from local counts.

endpoints.name: raymond
endpoints.fallback: An offline note, plus bundled fundamentals content.

endpoints.name: field-mission-generation
endpoints.fallback: A bundled script and bundled persona set.

endpoints.name: local-conversation-turn
endpoints.fallback: Scripted local lines from the bundled mission script.
